svg.title: Concept A, The Structural Report
svg.text: STRUCTURAL SURVEY OF A PAYMENT NETWORK · SHEET 1 OF 5
Merchants are stones, laid in courses by size. The bearings between them are
inferred from payment history alone. Pull one, and see what moves.
Fig. 1 Elevation, foundation to coping. Courses by tier; stone width by liquidity buffer on a log scale; keystones by systemic importance.
m0070 never receives ₹53.05 L from m0008, due at hour 19.
Point estimate; this snapshot carries no interval.
The bearings were estimated only from payments before hour 19;
nothing the shock did is visible to the model that drew them.
plan as chosen at the shock
Delay before the money lands: a scenario parameter, not a production timing.
At 48 h: 20.9 % cut, and nothing kept on time.
Payments made less late carry 97 % of what remains.
with a plan: mean cut, as chosen
Synthetic network. Every figure is replayed offline inside the synthetic generator; ₹ are analytic rupees; the disruption index is unitless.
